articles.description: — Backup Rodney Brown Jr. scored 24 points and fellow reserve Terry Copeland Jr. added 22 points and Seton Hall beat NC State 87-81 in overtime in the Baha Mar Championship game on Friday night.

articles.headline: South Dakota transfer Cameron Fens makes UNC debut in 88-72 win over Marshall
articles.description: Cameron Fens, a 7-foot South Dakota transfer who filed a lawsuit seeking to recover a year cut short by a misdiagnosed foot injury, and was granted a temporary restraining order, made his North Carolina debut, scoring nine points in a win over Marshall.

article.headline: Henige and Lungu have 21 each in Fresno State's 89-80 victory over UC Riverside
article.description: — Bradey Henige and Dragos Lungu had 21 points each in Fresno State's 89-80 win against UC Riverside on Saturday.
article.linkText: Henige and Lungu have 21 each in Fresno State's 89-80 victory over UC Riverside

categories.description: UC Riverside Highlanders @ Fresno State Bulldogs

event.description: UC Riverside Highlanders @ Fresno State Bulldogs

keywords: UC Riverside Highlanders @ Fresno State Bulldogs
article.story: FRESNO, Calif. -- — Bradey Henige and Dragos Lungu had 21 points each in Fresno State's 89-80 win against UC Riverside on Saturday. Henige also contributed nine rebounds for the Bulldogs (3-1). Lungu added eight rebounds. Ross Candelino shot 2 of 6 from the field and 15 of 16 from the free-throw line to finish with 19 points. Ben Waller led the way for the Highlanders (3-1) with 22 points, 10 rebounds and three steals. Aidan Rice added 18 points and three steals for UC Riverside. Tony Duckett finished with 15 points. Fresno State led 50-28 at halftime, with Lungu racking up 14 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
